BmsProfileSet.description: One profile parameter set: three 11-entry u16 curves that bms_profile_block_fill_* copies into the profile block (curve_a to +0x5E, curve_b to +0x00, curve_c to +0x16). Same layout in builds 4130, 4139, 4148 and 4168.

fields.name: curve_a
fields.description: First curve, copied to the profile block at +0x5E; 11 breakpoints indexed by the fill loop counter 0 to 10 (meaning not individually established).

fields.name: curve_b
fields.description: Second curve, copied to the profile block at +0x00 with the same loop index.

fields.name: curve_c
fields.description: Third curve, copied to the profile block at +0x16 with the same loop index.
